en: A color image of a serene mountain lake surrounded by dense coniferous forest. In the foreground, a young woman in blue clothing sits on a large rock by the lakeshore with a suitcase or bag. Across the water stands a picturesque building with two pointed red-tiled towers and a red roof, suggesting a lodge or pavilion. Several small boats and docks are visible on the lake, with people engaging in leisure activities. The background features steep, forested mountains under a clear blue sky.
